# Code Review: `interface/forms/eye_mag/report.php` This file has several **critical security issues** (SQL injection, missing authorization, stored XSS, variable-variable injection) and a number of **clinical-data correctness bugs**. Clinical bugs matter here because this report is printed and faxed. --- ## Critical / High — Security ### 1. SQL injection and cross-patient data leak in `display_draw_image()` ```php $base_name = $pid."_".$encounter."_".$side."_".$zone."_VIEW"; $sql = "SELECT * from documents where documents.url like '%".$filename."'"; ``` - **Injection:** `$pid` and `$encounter` can come straight from `$_REQUEST['ptid']` / `$_REQUEST['encid']` and are concatenated into SQL. This is SQL injection. - **Wrong-patient matches:** Even with clean input, `LIKE '%1_5_OU_...'` also matches `11_5_OU_...` and `21_5_...`. In addition, `_` is a LIKE single-character wildcard. The result is that **another patient's drawings can be rendered into this patient's report** (a PHI leak). - **Fix:** - Use a bound parameter. - Escape `_` and `%`. - Match on the full path or on `foreign_id = ?`. - Restrict to the correct patient. ### 2. Unauthenticated parameter override and no ACL check (IDOR) ```php if ($_REQUEST['ptid']) $pid = $_REQUEST['ptid']; if ($_REQUEST['encid']) $encounter=$_REQUEST['encid']; if ($_REQUEST['formid']) $form_id = $_REQUEST['formid']; if ($_REQUEST['formname']) $form_name=$_REQUEST['formname']; ``` - Any logged-in user can view any patient's or encounter's full eye exam by changing the URL. - `acl.inc` is included, but `acl_check()` is never called. - **Fix:** - Add an ACL check, e.g. `acl_check('patients','med')`. - Validate that the encounter belongs to the patient. - Cast the IDs to `int`. ### 3. SQL built by concatenation ```php $sql = "select * from facility where id=" . $_SESSION['pc_facility']; ``` Use `sqlQuery($sql, array($_SESSION['pc_facility']))`. ### 4. Variable-variable injection from preferences ```php $LOCATION = $prefs['LOCATION']; $$LOCATION = text($prefs['GOVALUE']); ``` - A DB value controls which global variable gets written. A pref row with `LOCATION='pid'` or `'encounter'` would silently redirect the report to a different patient. - `text()` is applied here, and values are then `text()`-escaped again on output, so they will be double-encoded. - **Fix:** Use an associative array (`$prefs[$LOCATION]`) with a whitelist. ### 5. `@extract()` of full DB rows into local scope In both `eye_mag_report()` and `narrative()`: - `@extract($encounter_data)` overwrites `$pid`, `$encounter`, `$id`, etc. with whatever columns exist in `form_encounter.*` and `form_eye_mag.*`. A future column such as `cols` or `choice` would silently change behavior. - The `@` operator hides failures. If the query returns no row, `extract(null)` is suppressed and every field is simply undefined. - **Fix:** Read from the result array explicitly. ### 6. Stored XSS — many unescaped outputs of user-entered clinical text | Location | Value | |---|---| | HPI | `echo $HPI1;` (note: `HPI2` and `HPI3` *are* escaped) | | Chronic problems | `echo " ".$CHRONIC2`, `$CHRONIC3` | | Impression/Plan | `$item['codetext']`, `$item['code']`, `$item['plan']` (only `title` is escaped) | | Orders | `$PLAN` items and `$PLAN2` | | Document notes | `$note->get_note()` | | Contact lens | `echo ($CTLOSVA?:"-")` (every sibling cell uses `text()`) | | Motility grid | `$MOTILITY_*` | | Signature | `$providerNAME` in the PDF branch | | Image `src` | `$pid`, `$filetoshow`, `$from_file` (not `attr()`-escaped) | | Amsler `src` | `$form_folder` | - **Plan text:** Use `nl2br(text(...))` instead of `str_replace` followed by a raw echo. --- ## High — Clinical correctness bugs ### 7. Left-eye motility grid shows the wrong muscle ```php ``` - The first cell should be `$MOTILITY_LRIO`. - As written, the LRIO value is never shown and LLIO is duplicated. This produces an incorrect exam record. ### 8. Typos in variable names hide data - **ccNear row:** `if ($ODNEARVA_1||$WNEAROSVA_1)` — `$WNEAROSVA_1` doesn't exist and should be `$OSNEARVA_1`. An OS-only near acuity is never shown. - **Gonioscopy:** `if ($ODGONIO||$OSDGONIO)` should be `$OSGONIO`. OS-only gonioscopy is never shown. - **NPC:** `if ($ODNPC or $OSNPC)` uses variables that are never set. The block then prints `$NPC`, so NPC is effectively never displayed. ### 9. Section display conditions ignore OS-only findings - **Retina:** The condition is `if ($ODDISC||$OSDISC||$ODCUP||$ODMACULA||$ODVESSELS||$ODPERIPH)`. A left-eye-only finding (cup, macula, vessels, periphery, CMT, or comments) hides the entire retina section. - **Refraction table:** It is gated on `$ODVA||$OSVA`. Current-Rx acuities are stored as `$ODVA_1` etc., so wearing-only Rx data likely never renders. ### 10. Autorefraction comments use a stale loop index After the `for ($i=1; $i <= $count_rx; $i++)` loop, the Autorefraction block uses `${"COMMENTS_$i"}`. At that point `$i == $count_rx+1`, so the value is undefined or wrong. ### 11. `$RX_TYPE` is not reset per row If `RX_TYPE_n` is null or unexpected, the previous row's type ("Bifocals", etc.) carries over to the next Rx. ### 12. Signature date is today, not the sign or encounter date ```php xlt('electronically signed on')." ".oeFormatShortDate() ``` - Reprinting an old report stamps today's date as the e-signature date. That is a misleading legal record. - In addition, the image is shown whenever a file exists. No signing or authorization status is checked. --- ## Medium — Correctness / Reliability ### 13. `CHOICE` / `choice` case mismatch ```php if ($_REQUEST['CHOICE']) $choice = $_REQUEST['choice']; ``` `$choice` is effectively never set from the request. ### 14. Inverted condition at the end of `eye_mag_report()` ```php } else if ($choice !="narrative") { narrative(...) } ``` An explicit `choice=narrative` renders nothing, which contradicts the docblock ("If not present it will display everything == 'narrative'"). ### 15. Short open tags (`\n">` is missing `echo`, so the title is empty. - Several strings are untranslated: `"Full to CF OU"`, `"Orders/Next Visit:"`, `"Comments:"`. --- ## Low — Maintainability / HTML ### 20. Debug leftovers and dead code - `xlt('Type').$count_rx` prints the Rx count into the column header. - `left_overs()` uses undefined `$table_name` and `$id`, and is dead code. - `full_report()` returns immediately; it also prints `` twice. - The DRAW branch contains a large commented-out block. - `$titleres` and `$facility` are queried but never used. - `$visit_date` and `$fname`/`$extension` are computed but unused. ### 21. Invalid or broken HTML/CSS - **Invalid CSS values:** `text-align:middle`, `text-align:bottom`, `margin:1 auto`, `padding:5 5 10 5` (no units). - **Bad attributes:** `heght=75`, and `` (duplicate `style` attribute). - **Column mismatch:** The refraction header has 10 cells; the CTL sub-header has 9. - **Unclosed `` sits inside the `ACT5CCDIST` conditional, so the layout depends on which tests were done. ### 22. Massive duplication - The HPI1/2/3 blocks, ACT grids, and refraction rows are copy-pasted. - This duplication is how bugs like #7–#10 slipped in. - Refactor into helpers, e.g. `render_hpi($n)`, `render_act_grid($suffix)`, `render_rx_row($prefix)`. ### 23. Miscellaneous - `&blahblah=".rand()` is used as a cache buster. Use a meaningful name or a content hash. - The file has a trailing `?>` and no newline at EOF, which risks stray output before headers or PDF generation. Drop the closing tag. - Typo in label text: `Constaast`. --- **Recommendation: Request changes.** Items 1–6 (SQL injection, authorization/IDOR, XSS, variable injection) and 7–12 (incorrect clinical data on printed/faxed reports) should be fixed before merge.
